 Follow General Hospital Preview: Valentin Realizes Time Is Running Out
 Roger Froilan Wed, October 28, 2026 at 11:04 AM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Image Credit: ABC In the next General Hospital spoilers video for Wednesday, October 28, 2026, Valentin gives Carly an urgent warning to move fast. Nina presses for a way to prove her innocence. Britt drops a pointed truth about Chase to Willow. 
 Key Takeaways 
 Britt tells Willow that her actions were all about Chase.
 Chase questions whether Dante should condemn Willow based on Sidwell's word.
 Brook Lynn decides it is time to do what she believes she should have done from the start.
 Ava pushes someone to stop stalling and give her what she wants.
 Serena promises Jason that something is about to make him very happy.
 Nina insists she is ready to prove herself innocent.
 Valentin warns Carly that she needs to move quickly.
 Coming up in Port Charles 
 Image Credit: ABC
 Britt (Kelly Thiebaud) tells Willow (Katelyn MacMullen), "You know why you did it? For Chase." With Willow's lawsuit against Lulu (Alexa Havins) already dragging more people into the mess, Britt may be calling out what really pushed Willow to go this far.
 Image Credit: ABC
 Meanwhile, Dante (Dominic Zamprogna) defends Lulu (Alexa Havins) , prompting Chase (Josh Swickard) to ask, "Would you damn Willow on Sidwell's word?" Chase has every reason to question whether Sidwell should be treated as a reliable witness after everything surrounding Lulu's article. Dante may believe Lulu got the story right, but Chase may argue that believing her is not the same thing as proving Willow guilty.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Brook Lynn (Amanda Setton) tells Tracy (Jane Elliot) that she "Better do what I should have done the whole time." After finally divorcing Chase and agreeing to 50/50 custody of Phoebe, Brook Lynn may be done letting anyone turn their breakup into another battle. If Tracy pushes her toward full custody or another legal maneuver, Brook Lynn could decide that putting Phoebe first means honoring the agreement she and Chase made without the lawyers making everything uglier.
 Image Credit: ABC
 Considering Ava (Maura West) will lawyer up , she tells Alexis (Nancy Lee Grahn), "How about we just skip to the part where you do what I want?" Joe's (Jonathan Bennett) investigation has Ava squarely in the Brennan (Chris McKenna) spotlight, and Baines (Alimi Ballard) is asking questions too, so collecting the favor Alexis owes her suddenly looks very practical. 
 Image Credit: ABC
 Elsewhere, Serena (Kelly Kruger) informs Jason (Steve Burton), "You are about to be a very happy man." Serena already learned that slipping paperwork past Jason is not exactly easy, so this time she may actually bring something he wants to hear. Whether the news involves Deception, Michael (Rory Gibson), or another Quartermaine problem remains to be seen, but Jason is not famous for looking thrilled, so Serena may be setting herself a fairly ambitious goal.
 Image Credit: ABC
 In Steinmauer, Nina (Cynthia Watros) tells someone, "Just tell me what I have to do to prove it to you." Baines has already admitted that the WSB may have rushed to judgment in blaming Nina for Jack's disappearance, which finally gives her a crack in the door. Nina has been sitting in prison for something she insists she did not do, so if there is a way to prove her innocence, she sounds ready to grab it with both hands.
 Image Credit: ABC
 Advertisement Advertisement And Valentin (James Patrick Stuart) lets Carly (Laura Wright) know, "We gotta go fast." They already know Lulu needs proof that the WSB has access to the drug connected to locked-in syndrome, while Nina's situation and Jack's disappearance are becoming tangled into the same problem. Valentin may see a way to help both women, but if the WSB starts closing ranks or Joe's investigation gets there first, whatever plan he and Carly are considering may have a very short shelf life.
